labeling.actionability: exposure context is labeled independently from compact-format structure; standalone is unknown; public documentation examples are public
labeling.development_partition: dev includes predeclared train and validation development partitions; holdout remains a frozen group-disjoint partition
labeling.format_outcome: positive means RFC 7516 compact serialization with a supported intact algorithm profile; negative means a spec-defined non-JWE or benign lookalike; malformed derivatives are separately adversarial and never negatives/TNs
labeling.grouping: template_family and seed_id values each belong to dev or holdout only once; holdout groups are absent from dev
labeling.span: half-open Unicode codepoint offsets covering exactly the compact JWE candidate
